ev.q: CDC analyzed the most recent 2020 multiple cause-of-death data from 46 states and New York City
PMRs were significantly elevated among ever-employed persons in 10 of the 23 industries and 11 of the 26 occupations
Death rates (per 100,000 ever-employed persons) were based on postcensal population estimates as of July 1, 2020.
PMRs adjusted for age, sex, and race were calculated.
In 2020, 316,023 (10.3%) deaths among ever-employed persons were associated with COPD.
Death rates were age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. population.
The COPD PMRs were adjusted by 10-year age groups, sex, and race.
The three industries with the highest PMRs were mining (1.33), accommodation and food services (1.28), and construction (1.23).
CDC analyzed the most recent 2020 multiple cause-of-death data

methods_quotes.q: A PMR with the lower 95% CI >1.0 indicated a significantly higher proportion of deaths associated with COPD in a specified industry or occupation than expected.
CIs were calculated assuming Poisson distribution of data.
PMRs adjusted for age, sex, and race were calculated.
Death rates were age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. population.
